newsitem.title: USA: Moderate quake hits California mountains.
newsitem.headline: Moderate quake hits California mountains.

text.p: A moderate earthquake jolted a mountain region of southern California on Wednesday, one day after another tremor shook a desert area there.
There were no immediate reports of damage or injuries from Wednesday's quake at 12.17 p.m. (2017 GMT)

A spokeswoman at the California Institute of Technology said the quake measured 5.0 on the open-ended Richter scale. It was centred about 18 miles (28 km) east-northeast of Little Lake in a remote area used by the U.S. Navy as an ordnance testing range.
The quake, some 120 miles (200 km) north of Los Angeles, came one day after a 4.4 quake about 11 miles (17 km) east of Desert Hot Springs, due east of Los Angeles.
The Caltech spokeswoman said Tuesday's tremor was an aftershock of the June 1992 Landers earthquake.
